issue.notes:
Proposal (not absorbed into beadrs-bad16411 per its red-branch scope rules) — the remote rust-verify lane cannot report or preserve its outcome. Discovered by beadrs-bad16411 attempt 3 while exercising that bead's preferred verification route.

MECHANISM (root-caused from the applied WorkflowTemplate and the cargo-remote source):
1. ~/.local/bin/cargo-remote submits rust-verify with only repo/revision/test-args. The template's github-repo parameter therefore stays at its EMPTY default; the post-pending step (runs FIRST, before verify, continueOn.failed) and post-final-status step both templateRef github-commit-status/post and fail on the empty repo — so no iad-ci/rust-verify commit status is EVER posted by a cargo-remote submission. Verified live: zero statuses on 1ddabad5 and on 1bf0bc52 (GitHub statuses API), while the cron lane posts iad-ci/bead-rs-ci fine on fbe2cf7a when params are set.
2. The verify script redirects ALL leg output (cargo check / clippy / test) to /tmp/verify-output and only cats it on CLONE failure; on a leg failure it exits 1 silently. podGC OnPodCompletion destroys the pod the moment it finishes and Argo GC reaps the workflow object within minutes, so the failing leg is unrecoverable after the fact.

EVIDENCE: cargo-remote-qs5k8 (rust-verify on 1ddabad5, submitted 2026-10-29T01:19Z from the clean clone) Failed at 01:48:45Z: verify main exit=1, post-pending exit=1, post-final-status exit=1; workflow object was already GC-reaped when re-queried minutes later; no status posted. Identical failure shape: attempt 2's cargo-remote-bkqw4 on 1bf0bc52. The identical tree passed every canonical leg green in the neutral-ground gate (fmt/clippy/clippy-msp/test all exit=0), so the verify failure's actual cause (toolchain drift in ronaldraygun/needle-ci-builder:0.1.12-with-deps vs local rustc 1.97.1, or an env-sensitive suite red) remains UNKNOWN and unrecoverable until this observability gap is fixed.

RESOLUTION OPTIONS (owner decision needed — hence a proposal):
1. cargo-remote derives and passes github-repo (jedarden/<repo>) so statuses post.
2. rust-verify template: cat /tmp/verify-output and /tmp/verify-result on failure, or emit them as saved artifacts; optionally echo per-leg markers to stdout so the streamed container log carries them.
3. Relax podGC for this template, or have client tooling capture /tmp/verify-* before completion.

Scope: ~/.local/bin/cargo-remote (codinghome + lab) and declarative-config/k8s/iad-ci/argo-workflows (rust-verify WorkflowTemplate). Cross-refs: beadrs-bad16411 (discoverer), beadrs-d49afe0a (separate bead-rs-ci planner-vs-plan-tag contract conflict).
issue.title: Proposal: rust-verify remote lane cannot report its outcome — empty github-repo param, /tmp-confined leg logs, podGC destroys evidence

issue.close_reason: Rejected by proposal triage (no dated failure or live observation to justify the work); rule proposal-triage-2026-11-01.1. Reopen to reconsider.
issue.description:
AGENTS.md makes NEEDLE compatibility contractual — 'NEEDLE compatibility is defined by research/specs/needle-cli-contract-v1.md' — and forbids claiming compatibility without passing the corresponding conformance suite. The visible conformance lanes are all feature-scoped (attempt-resolution, claim-epoch BR-T27, redaction BR-T18, unknown-field checkpoint); no bead owns a standing suite that exercises the v1 contract surface (command names, flags, exit codes, and the output/JSONL shapes the NEEDLE fleet depends on) end to end and gates release on it. Derive the conformance cases from the spec, add a runnable conformance target wired into CI, and reference it wherever NEEDLE compatibility is claimed.

---
Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
